target_customer: Marketers and individual creators who produce short form video for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
problem: Producing a steady stream of short form video for marketing is slow and expensive. Waffle offered an AI editor with hundreds of templates, and its site now describes a tool to run a TikTok campaign with an AI creator network.
business_model: software subscription (pricing not stated in sources opened)
product_category: AI short form video creation and posting

founders.name: Manuj Mishra
founders.background_notes: YC page says he ranked first at Imperial in maths and computer science.

founders.name: Diogo Valdivieso
education: EPFL, bachelor's in computer science; left a master's program

technical_complexity.rationale: Template based video assembly on top of existing generative video and speech models is mostly product engineering, with rendering and scheduling integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Templates and wrappers over third party models are easy to copy and CapCut, Opus Clip and others already served creators.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept shipping template and AI features; no source shows an outcome for Waffle itself.

market_need_then: Short form video demand from marketers was large in early 2025 and CapCut dominated creator editing, while AI generated video tools were multiplying.

branding.domain_note: Uses waffle.ai; acquisition details not found.

identity.visual_style: Not described in the page text read
identity.voice_and_tone: Short and direct, for example Start your own AI creator network

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly short word, but no press, community or brand evidence was found, and several other products use the Waffle name.

pivots.from: AI video editor with templates for reels, shorts and TikToks
pivots.to: Run a TikTok campaign with an AI creator network (research, create, post, track)
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from the difference between the YC description and the current homepage, so the date is approximate.

outcome_analysis: Waffle joined YC in Spring 2025 as a two person London team building a template driven AI video editor. No funding, acquisition or shutdown news was found, so the outcome is unknown and the company is listed as active. Its homepage now describes an AI creator network for TikTok marketing, which suggests a move up the stack from editing toward campaign automation.
notes: Funding searches found nothing for this company, so unknown funding is not zero. The pivot is an inference from the YC description versus the homepage and is undated. Searches surfaced only unrelated Waffle companies. Competitor results were undated listicles and vendor pages, so the competitor list is intentionally empty; CapCut, Opus Clip, Submagic and Instagram Edits are named in the risk rating only.
